name: pi.nvim
description: Two-way Neovim and Pi coding-agent bridge over tmux and Unix sockets

scripts.test:lua: nvim --headless -u NONE -i NONE -l tests/nvim-pi.lua && nvim --headless -u NONE -i NONE -l tests/nvim-pi-prompt.lua && nvim --headless -u NONE -i NONE -l tests/nvim-pi-quickfix.lua && nvim --headless -u NONE -i NONE -l tests/package.lua
scripts.lint: stylua --check lua examples tests/*.lua && node --check tests/nvim-bridge.test.mjs
